summary: magenta.nvim is a Neovim coding-agent plugin: Neovim (0.12.1+) loads lua/magenta, which spawns the esbuild-bundled Node server (dist/magenta.mjs, built by `npm run build`) and drives it over msgpack-rpc; the agent loop, tools (bash_command, edl edits, get_files, subagents) and provider clients live in that Node process. Model calls go through the official @anthropic-ai/sdk (Messages API, streaming, tool use), with a per-profile `baseUrl`/`apiKeyEnvVar`, so the proxy is reached by pointing the profile at $PROXY_URL with ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=proxy. There is no standalone CLI, so the overlay adds a headless init.lua driver: it configures a "proxy" anthropic profile from env, waits for the bridge, turns on the per-thread sandbox bypass (no bubblewrap in containers, otherwise every command/write blocks on an approval prompt), writes $TASK into the input buffer, runs `:Magenta send`, polls the thread's status line until it reads Stopped/Error/ABORTED, dumps the transcript to /out and quits. Thread archives (conversation.jsonl + meta.json) go to $MAGENTA_TEMP_DIR=/out/magenta.
dockerfile:
ARG BASE=debian:bookworm-slim
FROM ${BASE}

# magenta.nvim is a Neovim plugin whose agent runs in a Node process that Neovim
# spawns and talks to over msgpack-rpc. The self-contained runtime under
# /opt/harness therefore carries its own Node and its own Neovim; the base
# image's toolchains are left untouched.
ARG NODE_VERSION=24.21.0
ARG NVIM_VERSION=0.12.5

RUN apt-get update \
 && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends ca-certificates curl git xz-utils ripgrep fd-find \
 && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

RUN set -eux; \
    ARCH="$(dpkg --print-architecture)"; \
    case "$ARCH" in \
      amd64) NODE_ARCH=x64;   NVIM_ARCH=x86_64 ;; \
      arm64) NODE_ARCH=arm64; NVIM_ARCH=arm64  ;; \
      *) echo "unsupported architecture: $ARCH"; exit 1 ;; \
    esac; \
    mkdir -p /opt/harness/node /opt/harness/nvim /opt/harness/bin; \
    curl -fsSL "https://nodejs.org/dist/v${NODE_VERSION}/node-v${NODE_VERSION}-linux-${NODE_ARCH}.tar.xz" \
      | tar -xJ -C /opt/harness/node --strip-components=1; \
    curl -fsSL "https://github.com/neovim/neovim/releases/download/v${NVIM_VERSION}/nvim-linux-${NVIM_ARCH}.tar.gz" \
      | tar -xz -C /opt/harness/nvim --strip-components=1; \
    ln -sf "$(command -v fdfind)" /opt/harness/bin/fd

ENV PATH=/opt/harness/bin:/opt/harness/node/bin:/opt/harness/nvim/bin:$PATH
# Debian/Ubuntu /etc/profile resets PATH for root in login shells (bash -lc),
# so re-add the harness bins there as well.
RUN printf 'export PATH=/opt/harness/bin:/opt/harness/node/bin:/opt/harness/nvim/bin:$PATH\n' > /etc/profile.d/zz-harness.sh

# The plugin source. `npm run build` = `npm ci --production` + esbuild bundle
# to dist/magenta.mjs, which is what lua/magenta/init.lua launches at runtime.
COPY . /opt/harness/src
RUN cd /opt/harness/src && npm run build && npm cache clean --force

# Headless driver: a Neovim init file that configures the plugin from env
# (proxy base URL, model) and a Lua function that runs exactly one task:
# wait for the bridge, switch the thread to sandbox-bypass (the OS sandbox is
# unavailable in containers and would otherwise turn every command/write into
# an interactive approval prompt), submit $TASK, poll the thread's status line
# until it stops, dump the transcript under $MAGENTA_OUT_DIR, and quit.
RUN cat > /opt/harness/init.lua <<'LUA'
vim.opt.runtimepath:prepend("/opt/harness/src")
vim.opt.swapfile = false
vim.opt.shadafile = "NONE"

local model = vim.env.MAGENTA_MODEL or "claude-sonnet-5"
local profile = {
  name = "proxy",
  provider = "anthropic",
  model = model,
  fastModel = vim.env.MAGENTA_FAST_MODEL or model,
  thinkingModel = vim.env.MAGENTA_THINKING_MODEL or model,
  apiKeyEnvVar = "ANTHROPIC_API_KEY",
  thinking = { enabled = vim.env.MAGENTA_THINKING == "1" },
}
if vim.env.ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL and vim.env.ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL ~= "" then
  profile.baseUrl = vim.env.ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL
end

require("magenta").setup({
  profiles = { profile },
  activeProfile = "proxy",
  chimeVolume = 0,
  bellOnNotify = false,
})

local function log(msg)
  io.stderr:write("[magenta-task] " .. msg .. "\n")
end

local function find_buf(pattern)
  for _, b in ipairs(vim.api.nvim_list_bufs()) do
    if vim.api.nvim_buf_get_name(b):match(pattern) then
      return b
    end
  end
  return nil
end

-- Wait until the node process has bridged and the initial thread's buffers exist.
local function wait_ready(timeout_ms)
  local display_buf, input_buf
  local ok = vim.wait(timeout_ms, function()
    if vim.fn.exists(":Magenta") ~= 2 then
      return false
    end
    display_buf = find_buf("%[Magenta [0-9a-f]+%]$")
    input_buf = find_buf("%[Magenta Input [0-9a-f]+%]$")
    return display_buf ~= nil and input_buf ~= nil
  end, 250)
  if not ok then
    return nil
  end
  -- The active-thread dispatch follows buffer registration; give it a beat.
  vim.wait(1500)
  return display_buf, input_buf
end

function _G.magenta_check()
  local display_buf = wait_ready(120000)
  if not display_buf then
    log("check failed: magenta did not initialize (see /tmp/magenta.log)")
    vim.cmd("cquit! 3")
  end
  log("check ok: magenta bridge is up, thread buffers exist")
  vim.cmd("qa!")
end

function _G.magenta_run_task()
  local task = vim.env.TASK
  local out_dir = vim.env.MAGENTA_OUT_DIR or "/out"
  local total_timeout = tonumber(vim.env.MAGENTA_TASK_TIMEOUT_MS) or (2 * 60 * 60 * 1000)
  local uv = vim.uv or vim.loop
  local started = uv.now()

  if not task or task == "" then
    log("TASK is empty")
    vim.cmd("cquit! 2")
  end

  local display_buf, input_buf = wait_ready(180000)
  if not display_buf then
    log("magenta did not initialize (see /tmp/magenta.log)")
    vim.cmd("cquit! 3")
  end

  vim.cmd("Magenta toggle")
  vim.wait(500)
  -- No OS sandbox in the container: bypass it so nothing waits on an approval.
  vim.cmd("Magenta sandbox-bypass")
  vim.wait(500)

  vim.api.nvim_buf_set_lines(input_buf, 0, -1, false, vim.split(task, "\n", { plain = true }))
  vim.cmd("Magenta send")
  log("task submitted")

  local running = { "^Preparing%.%.%.", "^Executing tools%.%.%.", "^Streaming response", "^Aborting%.%.%.", "^📦 Compacting" }
  local finished = { "^Stopped %(.-%[input:", "^Stopped: ", "^%[ABORTED%]", "^Error[: ]" }
  local function status()
    local count = vim.api.nvim_buf_line_count(display_buf)
    local lines = vim.api.nvim_buf_get_lines(display_buf, math.max(0, count - 200), count, false)
    for i = #lines, 1, -1 do
      local l = lines[i]
      for _, p in ipairs(running) do
        if l:match(p) then return "running" end
      end
      for _, p in ipairs(finished) do
        if l:match(p) then return "done" end
      end
    end
    return "unknown"
  end

  local outcome = "timeout"
  local last_log = 0
  while true do
    local st = status()
    if st == "done" then
      outcome = "done"
      break
    end
    local elapsed = uv.now() - started
    if elapsed > total_timeout then
      log("timeout after " .. tostring(elapsed) .. "ms, aborting")
      pcall(vim.cmd, "Magenta abort")
      vim.wait(5000)
      break
    end
    if elapsed - last_log > 60000 then
      last_log = elapsed
      log("still " .. st .. " after " .. tostring(math.floor(elapsed / 1000)) .. "s")
    end
    vim.wait(500)
  end

  vim.fn.mkdir(out_dir, "p")
  local lines = vim.api.nvim_buf_get_lines(display_buf, 0, -1, false)
  vim.fn.writefile(lines, out_dir .. "/magenta-display.txt")
  log("finished: " .. outcome .. " (transcript at " .. out_dir .. "/magenta-display.txt)")
  -- let the thread archive under $MAGENTA_TEMP_DIR flush before the node job is stopped
  vim.wait(2000)
  if outcome == "done" then
    vim.cmd("qa!")
  else
    vim.cmd("cquit! 124")
  end
end
LUA

RUN cat > /opt/harness/bin/magenta-task <<'SH' && chmod +x /opt/harness/bin/magenta-task
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Run one magenta.nvim task headlessly in the current directory.
# Usage: TASK="..." magenta-task   or   magenta-task "task text"
set -uo pipefail
if [ $# -gt 0 ]; then export TASK="$*"; fi
: "${TASK:?TASK must be set}"
export MAGENTA_OUT_DIR="${MAGENTA_OUT_DIR:-/out}"
export MAGENTA_TEMP_DIR="${MAGENTA_TEMP_DIR:-$MAGENTA_OUT_DIR/magenta}"
mkdir -p "$MAGENTA_OUT_DIR" "$MAGENTA_TEMP_DIR"
nvim --headless -n -i NONE -u /opt/harness/init.lua -c "lua magenta_run_task()" </dev/null
rc=$?
cp -f /tmp/magenta.log "$MAGENTA_OUT_DIR/magenta.log" 2>/dev/null || true
exit $rc
SH
run_command: mkdir -p /out/magenta && nvim --headless -n -i NONE -u /opt/harness/init.lua -c "lua magenta_run_task()" </dev/null; rc=$?; cp -f /tmp/magenta.log /out/magenta.log 2>/dev/null; exit $rc
check_command: nvim --version | head -1 && node --version && test -f /opt/harness/src/dist/magenta.mjs && (cd /tmp && MAGENTA_TEMP_DIR=/tmp/magenta timeout 120 nvim --headless -n -i NONE -u /opt/harness/init.lua -c "lua magenta_check()" </dev/null)
notes:
Verified locally with Docker on both debian:bookworm-slim and buildpack-deps:jammy: check_command passes, and a full run against a fake Anthropic SSE server (tool_use bash_command then end_turn) executed the command without any approval prompt, wrote the file into the task cwd, saved /out/magenta-display.txt, /out/magenta.log and /out/magenta/threads/<id>/{conversation.jsonl,meta.json,tools}, and exited 0. With an unreachable proxy the run ends in an "Error Connection error" status and exits (no hang).

Key facts: (1) The model name is sent verbatim from MAGENTA_MODEL; it must match /^claude-(sonnet|opus)-[5-9]/ etc. only for context-window sizing (claude-sonnet-5 works). Thinking is off by default (MAGENTA_THINKING=1 enables it; the proxy's far-side model must support it). (2) Setting a baseUrl disables the Anthropic server-side web_search tool automatically, so no unsupported server tools are sent. (3) The harness also calls /v1/messages/count_tokens before requests for auto-compaction; failures there are only logged as warnings. It also issues a forced-tool-choice "thread_title" request at the start of a thread. (4) Sandbox: bubblewrap/socat/strace are absent in the container, so the sandbox reports "unsupported"; the driver's `:Magenta sandbox-bypass` makes shell commands and file writes run directly (equivalent to a full auto-approve). (5) Exit codes: 0 when the thread stopped (including model/provider errors, which are recorded in the transcript), 124 on MAGENTA_TASK_TIMEOUT_MS (driver aborts first), 2 if TASK is empty, 3 if the plugin never bridged. (6) A convenience wrapper /opt/harness/bin/magenta-task "task text" does the same as run_command. (7) The harness's own default context discovery still applies in the task dir (context.md, claude.md, .magenta/*.md, .claude/skills, .magenta/options.json), which is the plugin's normal behaviour.
